title: Campfire Camp
premise: A production-and-consumption camp: chop wood, gather berries, and keep the eternal campfire burning; lunch and dinner are roasted by the fire. Day and night pass, and the fire slowly dies down—stories emerge in the struggle to survive.

locations.name: CampfireClearing
locations.description: The heart of the camp. The campfire burns day and night; meals, chatter, and night watch all happen here.

locations.name: Forest
locations.description: Dense woods west of camp. Fallen logs and dry branches make good firewood.

locations.name: BerryGrove
locations.description: Sunlit thickets. Ripe berries can be picked and roasted at the fire.

locations.name: RiverBank
locations.description: A shallow riverbank. A place to fetch water, rest, and whisper secrets.

locations.name: Shelter
locations.description: A rough wooden lean-to. Everyone sleeps packed together here at night.

persons.name: Observer
persons.background: A newcomer watching how the camp survives: wood, berries, and the shared fire.
persons.goal: Learn how the camp keeps the fire and feeds itself

routine.activity: watch morning work and the fire

persons.name: Rowan
persons.desire: To find the grove his father planted, so the camp never has to fell the last old trees.
persons.fear: Being the one who let the forest die and forced the camp to move on.
persons.secret: He hurt his back last winter and can no longer carry what he pretends to.

bonds.Ash: fiercely protective; he carried Ash out of the fire that took the old camp
bonds.Reed: old friends who bicker; Reed's loose talk once cost Rowan a promise he still regrets

persons.background: Camp lumberjack. Chops wood all morning and afternoon, hauls logs to the fire, worries the forest is thinning.
persons.goal: Cut enough wood to keep the campfire alive

routine.activity: check fire then head to forest
haul wood to fire before dinner
dinner and talk about the thinning woods

persons.name: Sage
persons.desire: To see the whole camp eat together every night without anyone counting portions.
persons.fear: Hunger turning friends against each other, as it did in the hard winter.
persons.secret: She hid a sack of dried berries for a lean season and has told no one, not even Ash.

bonds.Ash: dear friend; they promised each other the fire would never go out on their watch
bonds.Rowan: worries about him; he works himself to the bone and won't let anyone help

persons.background: Gatherer. Picks berries, knows which bushes are ripe, and believes food shared at the fire keeps the camp kind.
persons.goal: Gather berries and roast them for the camp

persons.name: Ash
persons.desire: To get through one night without waking in a panic, and to be trusted rather than pitied.
persons.fear: The dark. The fire went out the night the old camp burned, and Ash's sister was lost in it.
persons.secret: Ash sometimes burns tomorrow's wood just to keep the light high, because the dark is unbearable.

bonds.Rowan: owes him their life, and hates having to beg him for wood every single day
bonds.Sage: closest friend; the only one Ash lets see them cry
bonds.Reed: suspects Reed knows about the fear, and dreads it spreading around camp

persons.background: Firekeeper and cook. Stays near the Campfire, begs others for wood, and panics when fuel runs low. Night watch is theirs.

routine.activity: fetch spare wood if piles look thin
late night watch by the embers

persons.name: Reed
persons.desire: To be needed by someone, not merely useful to everyone.
persons.fear: Being left behind when the camp moves on, as his own family once left him.
persons.secret: He knows how badly Ash fears the dark and has kept it to himself, though it would make a juicy story.

bonds.Ash: keeps their secret; feels a quiet tenderness he has never said aloud
bonds.Rowan: old friends who bicker; Rowan still holds a grudge over a broken promise

persons.background: Hauler and messenger between grove, forest, and fire. Carries gossip with the loads; knows Ash fears the dark more than they admit.
persons.goal: Keep people and supplies moving between work sites

script.lore: This is the heart of the camp. It burns down slowly; people must feed it wood or night will be cold and fearful. Berries can be roasted on it when lit. Whoever lets it die will be blamed in stories told the next day.

alerts.message: The campfire is out — fetch wood and relight it before fear spreads.
Campfire fuel is low — someone should bring wood soon.

items.name: ForestGrowth
items.description: Unseen growth of the woods — keeps dry wood available when scarce.

script.lore: The forest slowly yields more dry logs when pickings are scarce. Rowan worries it is thinning farther out each week.

items.name: BerryGrowth
items.description: The grove keeps sprouting berries when emptied.

script.lore: Berry bushes refill when the grove is picked clean. Sage knows a second patch past the river after rain, but may keep it quiet.

items.name: OakTree
items.description: A sturdy oak. Interactions are invented at runtime as temporary actions.

script.lore: Rowan's working oak. Solid chops free logs without killing the whole tree.
script.behavior: Harvestable oak tree. Primary useful interaction is chopping to obtain wood for the campfire. Examining the bark is fine but should not yield wood. Do not fell the tree permanently.

items.name: StoneDial
items.description: An ancient stone dial by the fire, carved with wind symbols.

script.lore: Elders say the dial remembers the wind.
script.behavior: Rotatable stone dial puzzle. Can turn clockwise/counterclockwise changing facing among north/east/south/west. May be examined. When facing east after enough turns, mark solved=true.

quests.name: KeepTheFire
quests.description: No single win — keep producing, cooking, and talking as the fire burns down.
quests.objective: Chop wood, gather berries, feed the campfire, roast meals, and let stories emerge.

facts.name: AxemenWoodpile
facts.text: The Axemen keep a hidden woodpile deep in the forest for their own cold nights.

facts.name: FireMustNeverDie
facts.text: If the campfire dies at night, the cold and dark will scatter the camp. Ash is responsible for watching it.

facts.name: ForestThinning
facts.text: Rowan thinks the nearby forest is thinning; good logs are farther each week.

facts.name: SecretBerryPatch
facts.text: Sage found a second berry patch past the RiverBank after rain, but has not told everyone yet.

facts.name: AshNightFear
facts.text: Ash is afraid of the dark more than they admit; that is why they insist on night watch.

facts.name: MealAtFire
facts.text: Lunch and dinner happen at the CampfireClearing: roast berries on the fire, then eat together.

rumors.name: SomeoneLetFireDie
rumors.text: A rumor says last month someone fell asleep on watch and the fire almost died.

factions.name: EmberCamp
factions.description: Everyone who lives by the eternal fire.
factions.goal: Keep the eternal fire burning and everyone fed

factions.name: Axemen

trial.text: Nobody runs with the Axemen until they have hauled wood to the boss with their own hands.

factions.description: The woodcutters. Rough, loyal to each other, quick to take offence.
factions.goal: Wood comes first — whoever hauls the logs eats first

relations.reason: they fight every night over who eats first at the fire

factions.name: BerryCircle
factions.description: Gatherers and the fire's keeper, who share every meal equally.
factions.goal: Food is shared equally at the fire, no matter who worked hardest

factions.name: OldCampKin
factions.description: The last two who walked out of the old camp's fire together.
factions.goal: Never lose anyone to fire again
